body:
Place the existing Triage form in PageFrame and use shared Clean Look card, field and status tokens. The clinical script matches current main except for the PageFrame import; guideline calculations, lower-zone restrictions, versions, retry keys and submit behavior are unchanged. No backend, permission, migration or assertion change is included.

The final page-local correction gives Use the suggested zone a 36px desktop minimum while retaining 44px below 1024, plus a semantic keyboard focus ring. Current main is merged normally. This is a presentation foundation, not full demo-content parity.

Validation: all 2,205 frontend tests pass with no skips, full TypeScript and production build pass, and scoped ESLint/Prettier/diff checks pass. Independent review verifies the exact source and target patch. Six independently executed actual-Vue component checks with final production CSS cover 390/768/1440 in both themes: targets are 44/44/36px, keyboard focus is visible, and Enter resets to the supplied suggested zone, with no overflow, errors or writes. The explicit synthetic-prop harness does not claim authenticated clinical or full-shell validation. Existing historical appearance evidence remains separately qualified. Fresh exact-head CI and current-main containment are required before merge.
